transcript.text: bosch washer FD 9409 not draining. ive cleaned the filter already. what part do i need?

I can't tell you which part you need yet, because that depends on what is actually stopping the water draining, and the filter you've cleaned has already been ruled out. Finding the faulty part is the job for an engineer. From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
